title: Iran Goldstein hostility -> gold
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT Iran Goldstein 20d z-score below -1.5 (hostile actions) leads gold higher by 1-2 days (+); trade long GLD 3d [gdelt.irn.goldstein -> finance.GLD.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.goldstein rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long GLD next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT Iran fight_events 20d z-score above 1.5 (kinetic escalation) leads GLD absolute return (volatility) higher by 1-3 days (+), a volatility rather than direction test after Goldstein->GLD direction failed OOS; trade long GLD 3d [gdelt.irn.fight_events -> finance.GLD.abs_return] (parent: R2-0100)
